# Published metrics

<!-- Generated by pipeline/build_platform_artifacts.py from models/published_metrics.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

The single authoritative table of ASTRA's published results (sprint task SP-18). Every number comes from [`models/published_metrics.json`](../models/published_metrics.json), which cites its source. The trained weights are not in the repository ([model_recovery.md](model_recovery.md)), so only the test-set point metrics can be recomputed here, from the committed confusion matrices.

**Status:** *computed*: recomputed from a committed confusion matrix or training history. *recorded*: copied from the cited report; needs the weights to recompute. *unverified*: the cited report contradicts committed evidence.

## Superseded results

Results of an earlier experiment on a 269-star dataset (validation split of 54 stars), before the 944-star Phase 6 freeze. They are not results of the frozen dataset and must not be shown as such. Source: `docs/engineering-log/phase7_benchmark_report.md`. They include the cross-validation summary (mean validation accuracy 84.68%), calibrated ECE 0.0478, NLL 0.5332, entropy 0.5250 / 0.8407 nats and a selective-prediction table that the README used to show as current results.

## Conflicts and how they were resolved

- **CNN dual-branch test metrics.** phase7_testset_results.md (7A): macro F1 0.7654, weighted F1 0.7738, accuracy CI [71.13%, 84.51%]; ground_truth_metrics.md (7C): macro F1 0.7635, weighted F1 0.7756, accuracy CI [71.83%, 84.51%]. Resolution: 7C: it matches the published CNN confusion matrix; 7A does not.
- **Calibrated ECE of the shared transformer.** phase7_benchmark_report.md: 0.0478 (earlier 269-star experiment); ground_truth_calibration.md: 0.0442 (test split). Resolution: 0.0442; 0.0478 belongs to the superseded experiment.
- **Calibration temperature of the shared transformer.** optimal_temperature_transformer_shared.txt: 1.257665 (hash-locked in model_registry.json); optimal_temperature.txt: 1.258631; training/uncertainty.py fallback: 1.2944. Resolution: 1.257665 is the published temperature; the other two are not used for published results.

## Numbers without a source

- `astra-platform/src/lib/data/constants.ts DATASET_LINEAGE` (3200, 2847, 1621, 1102, 978): Stage counts of the data-collection funnel; no file in the repository records them.
- `astra-platform/src/lib/data/constants.ts SELECTIVE_PREDICTION_DATA`: Coverage/accuracy table matching no report; not used by any page.
- `astra-platform/src/lib/data/constants.ts PER_CLASS_ECE`: Per-class ECE halving after calibration; contradicts ground_truth_calibration.md; not used by any page.
